subject: Clarifying vendor scope, data boundaries, and SOC 2 details

Thanks for the demo today. A few items security needs before we can move to procurement:

- Current SOC 2 status and most recent audit scope (in-scope systems).
- Any attestations or HIPAA / GDPR posture notes for PHI/PII handling.

Jamie — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Recap:
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (controls over system availability, security, and data privacy). Latest audit report covers our hosted API and control plane; private deployments have separate attestations when requested.
- We support GDPR controls and can sign data processing addenda; HIPAA feasibility depends on deployment mode (Dedicated/Private recommended for PHI).
- Primary subprocessors: AWS (compute/store), GCP (replication/backup in select regions), Segment (analytics), Sentry (error telemetry) — see attached csv for full current mapping.

Next steps / owners:
1) I’ve attached our subprocessor export and a vendor questionnaire template.
2) Soojin (security) will lead the questionnaire responses and can provide the SOC 2 summary and supporting artifacts.
3) Proposed timeline: questionnaire returned in 5 business days; SOC 2 evidence within 2 business days of request. If you need HIPAA-specific controls, we should scope a short technical call.

Attachments: redwood-subprocessor-list-20260702.csv, vendor-security-questionnaire-template.pdf

Can you confirm the main contact for procurement and whether data residency (US-only) is required? If so we’ll mark the Dedicated/VPC options as preferred in our responses.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 scope, data handling notes, and questionnaire plan

Hi Jamie / Logan —

Adding a few specifics from Security to speed your review: 

SOC 2 / Audit artifacts
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II; last audit period: 2025-09-01 to 2026-03-31. We can provide the SOC 2 report under an NDA. I’ve attached a 1-page audit summary with the in-scope systems. (SOC2-audit-summary-2025.pdf)

Data classification & residency
- For Hosted API (default): customer data is isolated logically; we persist request logs and metrics for up to 90 days (configurable). We offer region controls in EU/US/APAC for data residency on Dedicated and Private.
- For PHI: we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment. Hosted can be used with strict contractual safeguards and field-level redaction but is not our recommended default for PHI.

Subprocessors & data flow notes
- Core infra: AWS (us-east-1 primary), GCP (backup/analytics), and a small set of managed services (Segment, Sentry).
- Embedding models: executed in our serving runtime; model artifacts are not shared with third parties unless a customer requests model hosting with a partner.
- We do not sell customer data; usage telemetry is aggregated for service quality.

Questionnaire approach
- I’ll intake the questionnaire in our RFP tracker and provide sectioned answers: Org & people, Infrastructure, Data protection, Logging & retention, Incident response, Compliance.
- ETA: first pass answers in 3 business days, full artifact package in 7 business days depending on NDA/artifact requests.

If you can share the vendor questionnaire (or point to your procurement form), I’ll intake it now and route to engineering for any technical clarifications.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
